Title: A Simple Discovery

It was one of those ubiquitous jars with a wide mouth, used for holding nails or screws in the past. Lifting it, I noticed it was filled with what appeared to be various small metal objects: old coins, tacks, and even some tiny bent wires.

I've always been a collector of these odd found objects—little trinkets I pick up from the ground or find in unexpected places. I never really thought much of them, just stored them away.
